answers.ma_evidence: To sketch the graph of $y=4^x-1,$ we take the graph of $y=4^x$ and shift it $1$ unit down. The $y$-intercept moves from $(0,1)$ to $(0,0),$ and the horizontal asymptote moves from $y=0$ to $y=-1.$
